purpose: Scoped private hints, supersession and conflict-safe shared coordination.
use: Sharing hints, messages, leases, coordination entries or runtime instructions with other runtimes of the project: use attributable, conflict-safe records.
semantic_conditions: Shared records are scoped data, never authority; shared instructions project canonical policies; concurrent writers must not lose updates or reuse IDs.
mandatory_preconditions: Same-project binding, provenance, freshness and an exclusive-create or compare-and-swap write primitive.
postconditions_verification: Conflicts preserved, material facts promoted to canonical state, expired entries not treated as current.
